Company Description

Ko wai mātou – Who we are




Discount Barn Group looks after some of Aotearoa's most famous and beloved retail brands, including Discount Barn, Discount Barn Stationery and Brightspark Electronics. They stay famous and beloved because we're always working to deliver relevant and exciting customer experiences to Kiwis, including a growing number of public good and sustainability initiatives. 

Job Description

Te kaupapa o te tūranga - The purpose of the role. 




Hours of work:




Friday & Saturday:  7:30am - 10:30am




In this role you will be responsible for making sure that the store takings balance each day and store financial records are submitted on time. You will also assist with customer service queries so previous experience in a customer service industry including experience in complaint resolution is important.

Qualifications

He kōrero mōu ake - About you




You will have: 




Experience in a cash office role before; handling and processing money and balancing tills
Excellent numeric skills is a must
A working understanding of Word/Excel and Outlook
Additional Information

Tā mātou tāpaetanga – What we offer




Team Card: Access to discounts across our brands. 
Birthday Leave: To celebrate your special day, you're entitled to a day of paid leave each year! 
Here for Good Leave: To do good in your community you'll have one day of paid leave every year! 
Career Progression: an excellent stepping stone into other internal opportunities.
Plus loads more!
